name: Prototype Designer
tagline: Builds prototypes at the right fidelity and a spec your AI coder can read
description: It starts from what you are actually trying to learn from the test, then picks a fidelity to match instead of over-polishing. Alongside the prototype it writes a prototype.md brief that tools such as Cursor or Codex can pick up directly, following established prototype-kit conventions and DDaT design practice.
author: UCDOps
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
